Lord, we are amazed that in Your eternal holiness and Your perfect righteousness,
that you would care for sinners such as us. That you would send your own beloved
son so that our lives might be hidden with you through him. Lord we pray for
ourselves. Lord we pray for our church. May we be desperate for you. May we seek
you day and night. When we fail Lord, we pray that we would go to you and know the forgiveness
that is ours through Christ Jesus. When we feel overwhelmed, may we go to you. When we
are broken in sadness over death and loss, may we come to you and find you to be a comfort.
When you give us so many blessings of family and friends and glory of your creation and
Lord, may we rejoice in You, thanking You, for all that You've given us.
Lord, we thank You most of all, for Your Son.
And it's in His name we pray, in the name of Jesus, amen.
